calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical OPAQUE black-and-white segmentation at exactly 1536 x 1024, no transparency.
The ONLY input image is the complete primary-approved Uika reading apricot mother. Recolor EXISTING source-visible pixels IN PLACE, not a new person or portrait: all pixels belonging to Uika and the open book physically supported in her lap become pure WHITE; all room and furniture pixels become pure BLACK. Keep the input's exact full canvas, small right-bench position, scale, pose, head, hands, knees and shoes. No crop/zoom/recenter/anatomy redraw.
Registration guides: head is at the far-right window bench around x=1340..1455,y=300..420; lap and held book around x=1240..1430,y=485..585; complete shoes near x=1125..1260,y=700..765. Trace the source contour rather than boxes. Do not enlarge the person or raise the head to y=200. Most of the image and all corners remain black.
White includes the original short blonde bob and fine hair, face/neck, white T-shirt, both arms/hands/every finger, long taupe skirt/hem/folds, two visible calves/ankles/socks, both complete WORN sneakers, and the FULL OPEN BOOK (cover and every page edge) that is actually held on her thighs. All surfaces become solid white regardless of dark print/color or original folds. No internal face/cloth/book drawing.
Black excludes every pillow/cushion/bench/wood, desk/chair/lamp/cup/book-on-desk, floor/rug, curtains/window/lake/plants and all cast/contact shadows. Actual room gaps between the book and arm, under the lap, between legs/shoes and between genuine fingers remain black. Do not turn a pillow into her shirt/shoulder silhouette or merge a bench edge with the skirt.
Only a narrow antialias on the actual silhouette edge. No gray glow, blur, shadow, color pixels, text, labels, UI, logo, watermark, arrow, inset or border. This source-registered matte will carry the ORIGINAL mother RGB later, never a redrawn figure.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical SAME-CANVAS clean background extraction, not a room redesign.
ONLY INPUT is the complete primary-approved Uika reading apricot mother, 1536 x 1024. Remove ONLY Uika, her worn clothes/socks/sneakers, the open book held on her lap, and narrow local body/foot contact shadows. Reconstruct the exact pillow/cushion/bench/floor immediately behind them as a plausible EMPTY version of THIS SAME mother scene.
Preserve exact canvas/camera/perspective/geometry: the full window frame and four connected corners, original lake/campus view, curtains, rear-left table/chair/shelves/framed drawing, right desk/chair/lamp/cup/book-on-desk, window bench/right pillows/throw, floorboards and rug all stay where they are, at the same size and warm light. The right cushion may relax where her back/hips rested, but do not move/replace pillows, widen bench, rotate chair, shift lamp or invent a new furniture layout.
Keep source pixels outside the removed small far-right person footprint in place. No human, hair/skin/finger/skirt/sock/shoe remnant, floating lap book, silhouette, ghost or leftover body shadow. No new prop, white gradient, empty wall, crop, zoom, text/UI/logo/watermark/border/inset. Return the complete same-size opaque empty room with only that local removal repaired.
